sentences.text: This animal belongs to an ancient group of birds known as basal ornithuromorphs.
Scientists Ya-Ming Wang, Jingmai O'Connor, Da-Qing Li, and Hai-Lu You named this genus in 2013.
Taxonomists place it within the class Aves, the subclass Avialae, and the family Ornithuromorpha.
It lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago in the Xiagou Formation of northwestern China.
